seo.pirateDescription: Research at NO Anchor University: seventeen research clusters, eight outposts on a clickable treasure map, and expeditions looking for crew. A hackathon parody of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

pirate.title: Treasure Hunting
pirate.lede: The treasure is knowledge, mostly. Seventeen research clusters, eight outposts and a steady stream of expeditions looking for crew.

facts.label: Knots catalogued. Thirty-one cannot be untied

pins.name: Institute for Parrot Linguistics

pirate.heading: The map of outposts
pirate.tagline: Each X is an outpost. Click one to see what it is digging for.
pirate.hint: X marks the spot. All eight of them.

pins.name: Gold D. Roger Centre for Finding Things
pins.text: Searches for anything the ship has lost. Current priority: the anchor. Second priority: the Captain’s reading glasses.

pins.name: Centre for Applied Knot Theory
pins.text: Mathematicians and sailors working together on knots. They disagree about almost everything, which is why it works.

pins.name: Lighthouse Laboratory
pins.text: Studies light, signals and how to tell other ships where we are, once we know.

pins.name: Institute for Parrot Linguistics
pins.text: Works out what the parrots are saying. Early results suggest it is mostly about crackers.

pins.name: Centre for Renewable Wind
pins.text: Wind is the only fuel a pirate ship has ever needed. This centre is trying to get the rest of the world to agree.

pins.name: Fresh Water Station
pins.text: Turns sea water into drinking water, and drinking water into very long reports.

pins.name: Cannon Safety Board
pins.text: Makes sure nothing on board goes bang unless it is meant to.

pins.name: Map Room Digitisation Unit
pins.text: Scanning three hundred years of maps. So far they have found twelve that are correct.

pirate.heading: Seventeen treasure-hunting parties
pirate.tagline: Every department runs its own research cluster. Between them they cover the ground, everything under it and most things above it.
